title: The Táncház Movement: Urban Youth Discover Folk Roots
grammar: Ablaut twin-words and movement reduplications (*izeg-mozog, mendemonda, irul-pirul, tarka-barka*)
goal: I can recount how urban youth revitalized authentic village folklore in the 1970s táncház movement.
I can deploy vowel-alternating (ablaut) twin-words to depict motion, hesitation, and sensory variety.
I can talk about traditional dance-house cycles, field collecting, and living folklore heritage.
